note: Both sets capture the same six facts with correct bindings, but Set A's austenite-range claim is better supported: its quote explicitly ties 15-20 C to the existing Dynalloy wire specification, whereas Set B attaches the Irvine, CA annual-temperature condition to a truncated quote that does not support it. Set A also gives the complete value '200C to cryogenic temperatures' while Set B drops the unit word. Otherwise the pull-force, actuation-force and louver claims are equivalent.
